title: Warm-up 2: Sign In
text: Alex comes back to shop.example. The browser carries the request; the authenticator answers it.
held: The browser said where the page came from, and a person confirmed before anything was signed.

cards.label: Pass it on, adding the address the page was really loaded from
Pass it on with whatever site name the page gives
cards.why: A page can call itself anything. The browser's job is to state the real origin, which the page can't change.

cards.label: Ask Alex to confirm, then sign with shop.example's key
Sign straight away without asking
cards.why: If nobody has to be there, malware on the device can sign in whenever it likes. A touch proves a person is present.
